# ccx

> Session viewer for coding agents: a single-binary Go CLI and web UI
> that browses, searches, traces, and exports Claude Code (~/.claude),
> Codex (~/.codex), and Grok Build (~/.grok) sessions. Read-only by
> design — it never modifies agent session files.

Repository: https://github.com/thevibeworks/ccx. The JSON that
`ccx trace` and `ccx log` emit is a versioned contract; read the
schema reference before consuming it programmatically.

## Getting started

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/README.md): what ccx does, install, usage for every command, configuration
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): get set up and ship code in 5 minutes, no ceremony
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/CHANGELOG.md): every release with the reasoning behind each change

## Reference

- [JSON schema contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/docs/schema.md): all emitted kinds (ccx.outline.v1, ccx.turn.v1, ccx.trace.v2, ccx.related.v1, ccx.log.v1), versioning policy, semantics consumers must know
- [Claude Code / Codex session format reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/docs/devlog/2026-04-02-session-format-reference.org): the on-disk JSONL formats ccx parses, observed from real sessions
- [Grok session format reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/docs/devlog/2026-07-15-grok-session-format.org): ~/.grok layout, chat_history/updates/summary shapes, mapping onto ccx's model

## Agent skills

- [ccx skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/skills/ccx/SKILL.md): the full command tree and usage patterns, embedded in the binary via `ccx skills install`
- [ccx-recap skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/skills/ccx-recap/SKILL.md): what did the agent actually do — recap a session or time window from trace evidence
- [ccx-retro skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/skills/ccx-retro/SKILL.md): where did it go wrong and what should change — evidence-cited rule patches behind a human gate

## Optional

- [Q3 goal contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/docs/2026-q3-goal.md): the standing roadmap — release gate, Grok parity, shell redesign, runner bridge, launch
- [Trace v2 design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/docs/devlog/2026-07-07-trace-v2-recap-retro.org): turns, steps, and the recap/retro skills built on them
- [Context folding design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/docs/design/0001-context-folding.md): folding a session trace into auditable decisions
- [Evidence and citations design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/docs/design/0005-evidence-citations-lessons-from-semantica.md): why every claim ccx makes carries a walkable anchor
- [Session connections design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thevibeworks/ccx/main/docs/design/0006-session-connections.md): the deterministic relations between sessions and the evidence behind each
- [Devlog directory](https://github.com/thevibeworks/ccx/tree/main/docs/devlog): dated decision records for every significant change
